<!--
  The links of a top bar in a row; the current one carries aria-current. side: all, or the first or second half

-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { NavLink } from "../blocks/nav-bar.types";

export type NavLinksProps = {
  links: NavLink[];
  current?: string;
  side?: "all" | "left" | "right";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.vue";

const { links, current = "", side = "all" } = defineProps<NavLinksProps>();
const count = computed(() => links?.length ?? 0);
</script>

<template>
  <Group v-if="((links?.length ?? 0) > 0)" gap="4" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
    <template v-for="(l, i) in links" :key="l.id">
      <MenuEntry
        v-if="(((side as string) === 'all') || (((i * 2) < count) === ((side as string) === 'left')))"
        :href="l.href"
        class="text-sm"
        :current="(l.id === current)"
        testid="nav-link"
      >
        {{ l.name }}
      </MenuEntry>
    </template>
  </Group>
</template>
